```{r}
#| include: FALSE

library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(polite)
library(pdftools)
```

```{r}
session <- bow("https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Minnesota_state_parks", force = TRUE)

result <- scrape(session) |>
  html_nodes(css = "table") |>
  html_table(header = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
try <- result[[1]]
try <- try[-1,]
try <- try[,-4]
try <- try |> rename(Acres = `Size[9]`)
```


```{r}
test <- try |>
  mutate(`Park name` = str_replace_all(`Park name`, "[.]", "")) |>
  mutate(`Park name` = str_replace_all(`Park name`, "[/]", " ")) |>
  mutate(`Park name` = case_when(`Park name` == "Nerstrand-Big Woods State Park" ~ "Nerstrand Big Woods State Park",
            .default = `Park name`))

```

```{r}
with_wiki <- with_wiki |>
  mutate(Acres = parse_number(Acres)) |>
  rename(Year = `Year Established[4]`) |>
  mutate(Year = str_sub(Year, 1, 4))
```

```{r}
visits <- read_csv("Seasonal_summary.csv")

total_visits <- visits |>
  filter (`Unit type` == "State Park") |>
  group_by(`Park name`) |>
  mutate(total = sum(`Vehicle visits`)) |>
  distinct(`Park name`, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  select(`Park name`, `System`, `Implementing agency`, `Unit type`, `total`) |>
  rename(name = `Park name`) |>
  mutate(name = str_c(name, " State Park"))

write.csv(total_visits, "total_visits.csv")
```

```{r}
with_wiki |>
  left_join(total_visits) |> 
  select(name, total, Acres, `Year Established[4]`) |>
  rename(year = `Year Established[4]`) |>
  mutate(year = str_sub(year, 1, 4))
```  

```{r}
numbers |>
  ggplot(aes(x = total, y = year)) +
  geom_point()

```

```{r}
visits <- read_csv("Seasonal_summary.csv")

seasonal_visits <- 
  visits |>
  filter (`Unit type` == "State Park") |>
  group_by(`Park name`, Season) |>
  mutate(total = sum(`Vehicle visits`)) |>
  distinct(`Park name`, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  select(`Park name`, `System`, `Implementing agency`, `Unit type`, `total`) |>
  rename(name = `Park name`) |>
  mutate(name = str_c(name, " State Park"))

write.csv(seasonal_visits, "seasonal_visits.csv")
```

```{r}
visits <- read_csv("Seasonal_summary.csv")

by_season_visits <- 
  visits |>
  filter (`Unit type` == "State Park") |>
  mutate(Season = str_sub(Season, 1, -6)) |>
  group_by(`Park name`, Season) |>
  mutate(total = sum(`Vehicle visits`)) |>
  distinct(`Park name`, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  select(`Park name`, `System`, `Implementing agency`, `Unit type`, `total`) |>
  rename(name = `Park name`) |>
  mutate(name = str_c(name, " State Park"))

write.csv(by_season_visits, "by_season_visits.csv")
```

```{r}
#joins visitation data with acres and year established data from wikipedia
numbers <- 
  with_wiki |>
  left_join(by_season_visits) |> 
  select(name, Season, total, Acres, Year) |>
  mutate(Year = str_sub(Year, 1, 4))

write.csv(numbers, "numbers.csv")
```

```{r}
numbers |>
  ggplot(aes(x = total, y = Year, color = Season)) +
  geom_point() 
```


```{r}
season <- read_csv("seasonal_visits.csv")
```

```{r}
season |>
  mutate(visit-year = str_sub(Season, -4, -1)) |>
  mutate(Season = str_extract(Season, "[^-]+"))
```

### Palmer Penguins

```{r echo = FALSE}
renderPlot({
  ggplot(numbers, aes(x = bill_length_mm,
              y = body_mass_g,
              color = species)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_smooth(method = lm, se = FALSE) +
    labs(x = "Bill length (mm)", 
         title = "Body mass (g)")
})
```

```{r echo = FALSE}
renderPlot({

                      color = Season)) +

         y = "Year Park Established",
         title = "Visitation by Year Park Established and Season")
})
```

### Geyser Eruption Duration

```{r echo = FALSE}
renderPlot({
  ggplot(faithful, aes(x = eruptions)) +
    geom_histogram(aes(y = ..density..), 
                   bins = as.numeric(input$n_breaks2),
                   fill = "white", colour = "black") +
    geom_density(adjust = input$bw_adjust2, colour = "blue") +
    labs(x = "Duration (minutes)", 
         title = "Geyser eruption duration")
})
```




```{r, echo = FALSE}
)
```
